# Data dictionary: model features

The 63 application-time features used by LightGBM. The scorecard uses the 13 marked in the Scorecard column. Missing shares are for the training (2012-2014) and test (Jul-Dec 2015) windows; single-field AUC is measured on the training window after binning (0.5 = no information). The decision for every one of the 151 raw columns is in `feature_audit.csv`.

Derived features: `fico` is the midpoint of the 4-point FICO range; `credit_history_months` counts months from the earliest credit line to the issue month; `emp_length_years` maps '< 1 year' to 0 and '10+ years' to 10; home ownership values other than MORTGAGE, RENT and OWN are grouped as OTHER; loan purposes with fewer than 2,500 loans are grouped into 'other'.
